c1-35-01.title: Communicative Challenge: What Went Wrong in the Message
c1-35-01.scenario: A friend asks why an important message arrived with an error.
c1-35-01.prompt: Tell your friend what may have happened.
cues: Say what may have disturbed the message
c1-35-01.target: Könnyen meglehet, hogy a zaj megzavarta a jelet.
c1-35-01.english: It may well be that noise disturbed the signal.
c1-35-01.canDo: I can say what may have happened to a message (*könnyen meglehet, hogy*, *nem kizárt, hogy*, *kellett, hogy legyen*).

c1-35-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Profiles and Data
c1-35-02.scenario: A friend asks what a company does with the data it collects.
cues: Name the company by what it does
Say what it makes of the data
c1-35-02.target: Az adatainkat gyűjtő cég profilt készít rólunk.
c1-35-02.english: The company that collects our data makes a profile of us.
c1-35-02.canDo: I can describe a program or a company with a participle before the noun (*a szokásainkat követő program*, *a gyűjtött adatok*).

c1-35-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Deleting Data
c1-35-03.scenario: A friend wants a company to delete their data and asks what to write.
c1-35-03.prompt: Tell your friend what to ask.
cues: Say what the company must do
c1-35-03.target: Azt kérem, hogy a cég törölje az adataimat.
c1-35-03.english: I ask that the company delete my data.
c1-35-03.canDo: I can say what a law or a user requires with *hogy* + subjunctive (*a törvény előírja, hogy …*, *az ügyfél kéri, hogy …*).

c1-35-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Brain and Computer
c1-35-04.scenario: After reading about Neumann János's book *A számológép és az agy*, a friend asks how the brain differs from a computer.
cues: Compare the brain with the computer
Say what the brain does at once
c1-35-04.target: A számítógéphez képest az agy lassabban dolgozik, de sok dolgot egyszerre végez.
c1-35-04.english: Compared with a computer, the brain works more slowly but does many things at once.
c1-35-04.canDo: I can compare the brain and the computer (*a számítógéphez képest*, *sokkal rugalmasabban*, *gyorsabb, mint*).

c1-35-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Do Machines Think?
c1-35-05.scenario: A friend asks whether a program really understands what you say.
c1-35-05.prompt: Tell your friend what the program seems to do.
cues: Say that it only seems so
c1-35-05.target: A program úgy válaszol, mintha értené a kérdést.
c1-35-05.english: The program answers as if it understood the question.
c1-35-05.canDo: I can say that a machine acts as if it understood (*úgy válaszol, mintha értené*).

c1-35-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Technology and Responsibility
c1-35-consolidation.scenario: A friend asks what you learned in this unit about technology.
cues: Say how the power of technology changes
c1-35-consolidation.target: Minél erősebb a technika, annál fontosabb az etikai ellenőrzés.
c1-35-consolidation.english: The stronger the technology, the more important ethical oversight is.
c1-35-consolidation.canDo: I can use the words for information, profiling, data protection, brain and machine, and responsibility.
